title: Pixel Dash
shortDescription: A one-button endless runner. Jump the gaps, duck the saw blades, and see how far you can push your streak before the pixels catch up with you.

title: Stack Tower Rush
shortDescription: Tap at exactly the right moment to drop each block dead centre. Perfect stacks stay wide, sloppy ones shave your tower down to a toothpick.

title: Drift Alley
shortDescription: Hold one key to drift, release to grip. Chain corners without touching a wall to build a multiplier and unlock the next car in the garage.

title: Neon Snake
shortDescription: The classic snake loop with a glow-up: speed ramps every ten pellets, and portals on the walls let you wrap around if your reflexes are good enough.

title: Hoop Streak
shortDescription: Flick the ball, sink the shot, keep the streak alive. The hoop starts sliding sideways at ten baskets and stops being polite at twenty-five.

title: Bubble Blaster Arena
shortDescription: Aim, ricochet, clear the board. Ninety hand-built levels plus an endless mode that keeps lowering the ceiling until you crack under the pressure.

title: Tank Duel Arena
shortDescription: Two tanks, one keyboard, walls that bounce your shells straight back at you. Best-of-five local duels or a solo gauntlet against escalating bots.

title: Slope Runner X
shortDescription: Steer a rolling ball down an infinite neon slope. Two keys, no brakes, and a speed curve that turns merciless somewhere past the 3,000 mark.

title: Cookie Empire Tycoon
shortDescription: Click one cookie, end up running a continental bakery cartel. Twelve upgrade tiers, offline earnings, and a prestige reset that multiplies everything.

title: Idle Mine Shaft
shortDescription: Dig, hire, automate. Every shaft you sink is deeper and richer than the last, and your elevator crew keeps hauling ore while the tab is closed.

title: Click Kingdom
shortDescription: Tap to swing your sword, then let mercenaries do the swinging for you. Boss timers, loot tiers, and a skill tree that rewards patient planning.

title: Capybara Coin Farm
shortDescription: The most relaxed clicker on the site. Coins drop, capybaras nap, and the only real decision is which hat to buy with your absurd surplus.

title: Idle Space Colony
shortDescription: Terraform a dead rock into a nine-dome megacity. Balance oxygen, power and colonists, then jump to a new system and do it all faster.

title: Burger Baron Idle
shortDescription: Flip one patty by hand, then buy the grill that flips a hundred. Unlock franchises city by city and watch the revenue counter refuse to slow down.

title: Crystal Tap Tycoon
shortDescription: Shatter crystals for shards, spend shards on drills, spend drills on bigger crystals. A tight thirty-minute prestige loop built for short sessions.
